title: Fare Prediction Websites and Transaction Prices: Empirical Evidence from the Airline Industry
near_miss_reason: Staggered binary design: routes gain fare-prediction (Farecast) coverage in 2008 or 2010, with never-treated routes, route FE and year FE. All five reported FE columns (one per fare percentile) add four time-varying market controls: AvgAPPaxM, LCCseatsMS, MarketSeatsK, HHIseats.
eligible_reason: The FE specification has the right structure: binary farecast switching on at market-specific years, two adoption cohorts (2008, 2010), never-treated markets, and market plus year FE. Every reported column includes time-varying market controls (average airport boardings, LCC seat share, market seats, seat HHI), so no column qualifies. The DiD specifications are two-period pooled OLS comparisons without unit FE.
design_notes: Final Code for Marketing Science.do lines 24-32: areg lnFare farecast AvgAPPaxM LCCseatsMS year08 year10 MarketSeatsK HHIseats if sample & Quantile==q, absorb(id), for q in 10/25/50/75/90%. Lines 37-77: 2x2 DiD per period pair (2006-08, 2008-10, 2010-12) with pooled OLS, group dummies, and time-invariant plus time-varying controls. Shipped data verified: in the FE sample (median quantile, 3,342 markets) farecast is 0 in 2006, with patterns 0-1-1 (1,487), 0-0-1 (1,265) and 0-0-0 (390), plus a few markets with missing years.
n_eligible_specs_note: Five near-miss FE specs (one per fare percentile). None is eligible as reported.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: 2008 and 2010, in the FE sample with 2012 excluded.

specs.treatment_definition: Indicator that Farecast/Bing fare-prediction information was available for the market (origin-destination route) in the observed quarter. In the FE sample farecast is 0 for all markets in 2006 and switches on in 2008 (1,487 markets at the median quantile) or 2010 (1,265 markets). 390 markets are never treated. farecast is 0 for all markets in 2012, and the FE spec drops 2012.
specs.controls: AvgAPPaxM, LCCseatsMS, MarketSeatsK, HHIseats (all time-varying market characteristics)
specs.cluster: none (conventional OLS SEs; no vce option)
specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying controls in every reported column
specs.outcome: lnFare (log fare at the 10th percentile of DB1B transactions)
specs.reported_location: Fixed-effects table, fare-percentile column (exact table number unknown; no article text)
specs.notes: Near-miss. Re-estimating without the four controls would give a qualifying staggered TWFE (2 cohorts plus never-treated, years 2006/2008/2010), but no such column is reported. A few markets are missing a year despite the transaction filters (slightly unbalanced).

specs.fe: none (pooled OLS with group dummies and year dummy)
specs.controls: AvgAPPaxM avgpopM avginccapK distK LCCseatsMS MarketSeatsK HHIseats
specs.exclusion_reason: no unit FE; time-varying controls; separate 2x2 comparisons with several treatment groups

data_files: PredictionWebsitesStata12.dta (71,245 market-year-quantile rows; DB1B fares plus Farecast coverage)
software_notes: Stata 14 code; data saved as Stata 12.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (abstract from OpenAlex). The abstract reports a 4%-6% price reduction 'in fixed-effects and difference-in-differences estimation models'. It is a good candidate for the near-miss category, since data and code are complete. Farecast coverage is 0 for all markets in 2012 (discontinued), so post-period switch-off is excluded by the authors' year!=2012 restriction.
